regime_notes: Hyperliquid crossed a fresh protocol-activity threshold: 24h perp volume is about $9.353B versus $44.361B over seven days, approximately 1.60x the preceding-six-day daily average. Fees are $2.92M/24h versus $13.94M/7d and holder revenue $2.19M/24h versus $10.67M/7d, each about 1.55-1.59x the preceding-six-day daily average. DefiLlama reports zero protocol incentives across 24h/7d/30d, supporting financially substantive rather than reward-driven activity.

The activity acceleration does not receive a portfolio scale-up because the external-demand leg weakened. U.S.-listed HYPE spot ETFs were reported to have $26.4M combined net outflows for Sep 7-11, led by BHYP at roughly $20.1M and THYP at roughly $6.3M; cumulative flows remain positive, so this is a conflict rather than a full institutional-demand failure.

Open interest is about $13.81B, below the recent ~$14.67B high, while 24h perp turnover accelerated. This indicates higher capital velocity/churn rather than a fresh stock of leverage. 24h liquidations are about $50.39M, so part of the activity increase is forced flow and is discounted.
HYPE is $79.49, approximately flat to the paper gross entry at $79.35 and all-in average cost $79.469025, but down about 5.6% over seven days. Price has not confirmed a new leadership leg.

HYPE structural gate remains PASS_WITH_MAJOR_DILUTION_CAVEAT: deep executable liquidity and native-token structure remain acceptable, but CoinGecko reports market-cap/FDV near 0.23 and a roughly 9.92M HYPE contributor unlock is reported for Oct 6. No hard gate failure surfaced.

Injective remains the strongest watch challenger but still does not clear the paper-entry threshold. DEX volume is $21.78M/24h vs $103.75M/7d and perps $77.51M/24h vs $364.12M/7d; stablecoin market cap is only $12.74M (+1.69% 7d) and 24h net inflows are just $9.6K. The canonical USDC migration is real but partly mechanical, and no new selective independently funded INJ wallet cluster was verified.

Solana remains high velocity at $2.099B DEX volume/24h, but that is below its $16.435B seven-day average pace; stablecoins are down 1.85% over seven days despite +$10.87M 24h inflows. Raydium tokenized-equity venue leadership remains a valid prior observation, but RAY still lacks fresh wallet/distribution reversal evidence.

No paper trade was executed. HYPE is held rather than added or trimmed because stronger non-incentivized protocol economics are offset by weaker ETF flow quality and absent fresh wallet confirmation. State.json and the immutable trade ledger remain unchanged.
